messages:
Sam G: Quick retro on the Cloud Alliance promo sprint — can we capture wins, friction, and 3 concrete follow-ups?
Priya N: +1. Wins: launch blog did well in r/DevOps, demo signups spiked after the benchmark snippet :tada:
Jordan L: Numbers: 420 demo signups, but only 38 MQLs. Conversion drop after webinar. Tracking shows some leads mis-tagged -> routed to small-business SDR queue.
Alex M: Content note — the benchmark narrative is solid but the ROI section is wordy. Suggest swap order: show cost-per-call reduction first, then latency graphs.
Kari (Partner Ops): Marketplace listing stalled — partner asked for SOC2 attestation link and category tag 'AI-inference'. Until that's in, listing won't go live. Partner PM paused co-email.
Sam G: OK action list: 1) Priya to draft webinar follow-up + 3-line exec summary. 2) Alex to tighten benchmark intro and add ROI-first hook. 3) Jordan to fix lead-routing rules in HubSpot + confirm segment. 4) Kari to chase partner for SOC2 link & category tag.
Priya N: I'll take #1. Draft ETA EOD tomorrow. Plan: short blog post + 2 social posts + 1 partner co-post.
Jordan L: I'll push the HubSpot mapping change. Proposed mapping snippet:
```
utm_source=partner-alliance -> campaign=cloud-alliance
lead.owner.queue = "enterprise-sdr"
lead.source_detail = "marketplace_listing"
```
Also adding an automated note if lead.company_size < 50 -> small-business queue.
Alex M: Will refactor the benchmark copy. Also prepping a 90s clip of the latency demo for social.
Kari (Partner Ops): Scheduling a 30m sync with partner PM and ops — options Wed 11:00 or Thu 15:00 PT. @Sam G please confirm.
Sam G: Wed 11:00 PT works for me. @RemindBot please set meeting and include agenda: SOC2 link, listing props, email cadence, routing handoff.
RemindBot: Meeting created: Cloud Alliance Ops sync — Wed 11:00 PT. Invite sent to partner-pm@cloudalliance.com, Sam G, Kari (Partner Ops), Alex M, Priya N, Jordan L.
Priya N: small follow-up — can we get a 1-paragraph partner quote for the blog? Kari, can you ask partner PM to share?
Kari (Partner Ops): Will do.
Sam G: Thanks all — good retro. We'll reconvene after the sync and close items. :thumbsup:
